indexTs.description: The COMPLETE index.ts of the group showcase page, starting at the mls header. Raw TypeScript only — no markdown fences. Must import and display every molecule of the group. The renderReferenceTable() method must be EXACTLY the 3-line delegating call described in the OVERRIDE section of the prompt — never hand-written table markup.

scenarios.description: The 'Quick reference' decision table, as DATA — one entry per row you would otherwise have hand-written as a rows/headers table.

scenario.description: A short description of a realistic use case, e.g. 'Simple quantity input' or 'Free typing with a mask'.

recommended.description: The SHORT names (no group prefix — copy them exactly from the 'Available molecules' list) of every molecule of THIS group that fits this scenario. A name not in that list is dropped, never guessed.
